readerEvidence.summary: Single-pass Astra transcription from all 56 original primary question, solution and marking-scheme pages, personally read across three hash-bound windows. Five independent original whole problems and existing IDs retained. All 37 final no-snap crops personally inspected. Alternate archive copies inventoried and compared mechanically; only alternate 1_sol.pdf page 1 visually read, with no full alternate-edition reading claim. Printed source discrepancies preserved, not silently corrected. No separate model checker.

pagesRead.observation: Personally read original first page alongside primary; same visible question and key opening. No whole alternate-file reading claim.

alternateSourceInspection.limitation: Only alternate 1_sol.pdf page 1 visually read; no full-content equality or full alternate-reading claim.

sourceGaps: No separate marking scheme for the non-scoring special-prize logo problem was supplied.
sourceDiscrepancies: The question source prints a garbled coil-current sentence and repeats L1; the atomics photon table repeats lambda_i for the intermediate photon. These printed forms are retained.

The mechanics key contains differing signs and indices, including the q power, positive speed in equation 1.40 versus incoming negative velocity in 1.42, and dropped force subscripts in 1.52–1.53 and 1.88–1.89. Both initial-direction cases and all printed formulas are retained.

The electricity key omits omega factors in the second line of 2.1 and prints a square-root impedance denominator in 2.5; 2.34 prints C4, 2.36 drops a minus sign, 2.47 uses positive cosine integrals, 2.59 has a negative right side, and 2.60 repeats L1. Figure 2.2 and 2.68 differ in the constant-current sign. The rubric corrects some expressions but not others and labels its final total question III. Both supplied versions are transcribed separately.

The optics key prints subtraction of A-prime/2 in 3.9 and 30.7 degrees in 3.10; several prose equation and figure references are offset from the numbered objects. The rubric repeats the printed minimum-deviation result.

The atomics solution heading prints Problem III although the question is IV. Electron notation varies between table and prose; 4.15 lacks the cross-term factor appearing in 4.16, 4.21 reverses inequalities from preceding text, and 4.27 reverses an inverse-wavelength subtraction. These statements and the printed final numerical values are retained.
The logo solution includes the supplied historical dates and physical explanation as printed. The source labels this as a non-scoring special-prize problem and supplies no separate scoring rubric.
